data: Apple reported net income of $99.80 billion in fiscal 2022 (the year ended September 24, 2022) and $93.74 billion in fiscal 2024 (the year ended September 28, 2024). That is a decline of about $6.07 billion, or roughly 6.1%, over the two years. Most of the fiscal 2024 drop came from a one-time income tax charge of about $10.2 billion tied to the European Commission's State Aid decision on Ireland. Without that charge, fiscal 2024 net income would have been above the fiscal 2022 level. For comparison, fiscal 2023 net income was $97.00 billion.
